annotations.title: Find one eSIM for a layover and destination

description: For a trip with a connection: finds Slashtel travel eSIM plans that cover the transit hub's country AND the destination country (and an optional second stop) on one QR code, cheapest first, with live prices in USD. Use it when someone flies via Dubai, Doha, Istanbul, Abu Dhabi, Singapore, Hong Kong, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Paris, London or another hub and wants data during the layover and on arrival without relying on airport wifi. If no single plan covers every country it returns one eSIM per country. Follow up with get_esim_plans using the returned code to get plan_ids, then create_checkout_link.

to.description: Destination country: ISO-2 code (GB, IN, US) or name (United Kingdom, India)

via.description: Transit airport code or city, e.g. DXB, Doha, IST, Singapore

via2.description: Optional second transit airport code or city

name: get_layover_esim
